question: Which keyboard shortcut is used to quickly save a workbook in MS-Excel 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + S**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ctrl + S** is the universal keyboard shortcut to save a workbook or document in MS-Excel 365 as well as other Microsoft Office applications.
 
• Using this shortcut ensures that the current state of your workbook is saved to the disk, preventing data loss during unexpected events like software crashes.
 
• The shortcut works across all versions of Microsoft Excel, including MS-Excel 365, Excel 2019, and earlier versions.
 
• Users can simply press **Ctrl + S** on Windows or **Command + S** on macOS to save their work quickly.
 
• In addition to saving manually, Excel 365 also offers an AutoSave feature when files are stored on OneDrive or SharePoint.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts in MS-Excel:** Excel provides various shortcuts for efficient workflow, such as **Ctrl + C** for copy, **Ctrl + V** for paste, and **Ctrl + P** for printing.
 
• **AutoSave Feature:** Excel 365 automatically saves files to OneDrive or SharePoint in real-time, provided the feature is enabled, reducing dependency on manual saving.
 
• **File Formats:** MS-Excel saves workbooks in formats like **.xlsx** (default), **.xls** (older format), and **.csv** (for data exchange). Users can select formats while saving.
 
• **Save As Functionality:** The *Save As* option allows users to save a copy of their workbook under a different name or location, accessible through the shortcut **F12**.
 
• **Cloud Integration:** MS-Excel 365 is integrated with Microsoft OneDrive, enabling collaborative editing, version history, and secure cloud storage.
